dogecoin.text: @hubdotxyz Including Dogecoin would also diversify the reserve, adding a coin with a different narrative and user base compared to the more technologically advanced cryptocurrencies.

@hubdotxyz If the US were to create a Crypto Reserve including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Cardano, and Ripple, and I were to add one more coin, I would choose Dogecoin. Dogecoin has a large and dedicated community, which could provide additional stability and interest.
